description: List the Android phones this computer reaches: each one's id and model (what phone tools take as device), its CodeDroid server, its link (connected, connecting or disconnected, with the last problem), and status: available, in_use (lease says who holds it, what for, and frees_in_s) or offline. Phones can be shared with other agents and computers: pick an available one, or claim_device with device "any". Quick: it asks only the phones already connected. codedroid_status connects and says how to fix a problem.
name: codedroid_devices
title: Paired phones
